subject.title: [RE-OPEN REQUEST] Indexing sync failure for jjr-iot-skill (Previous #2047)

question: Should production visibility for `janeXlab/jjr-iot-skill` be restored, and if so through which audited path after account, publisher, scan, moderation, deletion, license, and search-digest verification?
rationale: The public source path intentionally enforces several visibility gates, but anonymous checks cannot identify which private production state is blocking this skill or whether exposing it is safe.

options.title: Audit and restore through existing gates
options.body: Verify the production account, publisher, skill row, version, scans, moderation, deletion, license, audit log, and digest state, then repair visibility through the normal publish/admin path if safe.

options.title: Leave hidden until identity or artifact is verified
options.body: If account ownership, scan status, or moderation state cannot be verified, keep the listing non-public and ask the reporter for authenticated owner-side confirmation.

options.title: Split a broader search issue if needed
options.body: If the row is public but only digest/search state is stale, keep this issue for the specific production repair and track any general search-digest bug separately.

recommendation.title: Audit and restore through existing gates
recommendation.body: Verify the production account, publisher, skill row, version, scans, moderation, deletion, license, audit log, and digest state, then repair visibility through the normal publish/admin path if safe.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest routing candidate for the backend API, publishing, moderation, scan, and visibility-gate paths involved in the decision.
